scope: Read-only installed Genesis/libuipc material mapping + exact formula checks, not calibrated textile properties or a physical success certificate

source_evidence.finding: Genesis Cloth passes E/nu/rho/radius/bending/friction; per-scene mu adapter runs before initialization.
Mutates only triangles.mu; protects lambda/strain_rate/thickness/mass/is_fixed/bending/contact metadata; exact source/native region bijection.
Cloth actually uses StrainLimitingBaraffWitkinShell plus independent DiscreteShellBending; stale NeoHookean docstring is not actual implementation.
Genesis FEM substep is skipped for IPCCoupler; its FEM damping options do not control current cloth.
lambda=(Lamé lambda+2mu)*(2radius), mu=shear_moduli.mu(); native area weighting gives both effective coefficients units N/m.
W=lambda*sum(e^2+q*max(e,0)^3)+mu*(Fa dot Fb)^2, where e=norm(F a/b)-1. q=strain_rate is dimensionless, conservative, finite, not hard cap or viscous damping.
Rest triangle normal is rotated onto +Z to define Dm XY axes; a=(1,0),b=(0,1). Energy is W*restarea*dt². Backend copies coefficients at init.
Explicit raw coefficient is independent from E; units N*m via E*(2r)^3/[12*(1-nu²)]. Increasing membrane E need not increase bend stiffness.

rhombus_explanation.claim: This is an exact deformation-gradient counterexample: significant diagonal/principal extension can occur with zero axial stretching term. E alone cannot suppress it. It is not a prediction of any native run.

damping_scope.limitations: Installed public constitutions expose no viscous/Rayleigh shell setting. Plastic bending changes rest curvature/yield memory; not generic cotton hysteresis. Explicit velocity drag is possible only with additional callback/state handling, excluded from this narrow material update. Unchanged implicit integration/contact friction dissipate energy, but reduced rebound must be measured: increasing stiffness alone is no damping guarantee.

candidate_rationale: Increase membrane axial coefficient 5x and body/handle shear 20x/8x; keep very small independent bending coefficient and same mass. These are engineering trial values with meaningful units, not measured cotton/linen calibration. q=100 already makes axial positive strain increasingly costly; retaining it avoids conflating stiffness and damping.
